title: Submit exchange application
description: Complete all requirements to submit the university exchange application on time.

documents.source_text: Applicants must submit an official transcript, one reference letter, and the completed application form before the final deadline.

tasks.title: Confirm exchange eligibility
tasks.description: Verify GPA and standing requirements with the exchange office.
tasks.consequence_if_missed: Application cannot proceed without confirmed eligibility.

tasks.title: Request official transcript
tasks.description: Request an official transcript from the registrar's office.

dependencies.reason: Eligibility must be confirmed before requesting documents.

tasks.consequence_if_missed: The application cannot be submitted without an official transcript.

tasks.title: Request reference letter
tasks.description: Ask a faculty member to write and submit a reference letter.

dependencies.reason: Eligibility must be confirmed before requesting documents.

tasks.consequence_if_missed: The application package will be incomplete without a reference letter.

tasks.title: Upload supporting documents
tasks.description: Upload the transcript and reference letter to the application portal.

dependencies.reason: The transcript must be received before it can be uploaded.
The reference letter must be received before it can be uploaded.

tasks.consequence_if_missed: Supporting evidence will be missing from the application.

tasks.title: Complete application form
tasks.description: Fill out and review the exchange application form.

dependencies.reason: Eligibility must be confirmed before the form can be completed.

tasks.consequence_if_missed: The application cannot be submitted without a completed form.

tasks.title: Submit exchange application package
tasks.description: Submit the complete application package through the exchange portal.

dependencies.reason: Supporting documents must be uploaded before final submission.
The form must be completed before final submission.

tasks.consequence_if_missed: Missing the final deadline forfeits the exchange placement.
